shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large stone block/monolith
horizontal register or band dividing the surface
repeated small elements aligned in a row
raised vertical border/frame at the edge of the carved panel
justification: Both show shallow relief on a large stone face organised into horizontal registers, with a row of repeated ring/disc motifs beneath an upper band and a raised vertical framing edge, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a heavily eroded, largely abstract grid of circles and blocky glyph-like units, whereas B carries crisply cut, recognisable animal figures (quadruped, bird, serpentine forms) in an open field, so the manner and content of rendering differ substantially.
